start: Operator, you're jacked in. Build along the streets, then call the first wave.
wave_start_2: Contacts on the grid. Here they come.
wave_start_3: Next wave is moving. Stay sharp.
core_critical: Core integrity critical! Don't let anything else through!
defeat: The core's breached. We've lost the district.
endless: Endless mode. The corps won't stop sending them. Neither will we.
boss_titan: Titan Warframe on the grid. Heavy armor. Railguns and orbital strikes, now.
boss_overmind: That's the Overmind. Rogue AI core. Break its shield, then take the hull apart.
phase_titan: It's venting an EMP pulse. Towers near the Titan are down!
phase_overmind: The Overmind is hijacking our towers!
threat_runner: Street runners. Chromed-up punks. Nothing a pulse laser can't handle.
threat_drone: Hunter drones, airborne. Mortars can't touch them.
threat_brute: Heavy mechs. That armor shrugs off small hits. Railguns cut straight through.
threat_aegis: Aegis units. Their shields regenerate. Tesla coils eat shields for breakfast.
threat_phantom: Phantoms. Full optical camo. You'll need detection, or an uplink field.
threat_splitter: Replicators. Kill one and it bursts into nano-mites.
threat_medic: Patch drones. They repair everything around them. Take them out first.
threat_jammer: Signal jammers. Any tower in their field goes dark. Out-range them, or firewall your towers.
threat_courier: Data couriers. They'll grab a packet from the core and run for the exit. Don't let them out.
data_stolen: They've got a data packet! Stop that courier before it gets out!
data_escaped: Packet's gone. That one's going to hurt.
variant_mirror: Mirror plating on those units. Lasers will glance right off.
variant_insulated: Insulated hulls. Tesla arcs won't chain through them.
variant_thermal: Heat-sinked units. Cryo and fire won't stick to them.
mutators: Heads up. This wave is running modified hardware.
